# E0356: a normal-form lens is outside what the authoring form expresses

Decompile turns a normal-form lineage back into version files. It expresses
exactly the lenses the compiler produces: mappings that move, drop, orelse,
remap and each. A lens that computes a value is outside that, and Decompile
refuses it rather than approximate.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				n: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.a
			n: len(input.a)
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0356]: lens 0.0->1.0 is outside the authoring form: n is computed
 --> lineage.cue:1:1
  |
1 | name: "ship"
  | ^^^^
  |
  = help: the authoring form expresses the lenses Compile produces: mappings that move, drop, orelse, remap and each
```
